# Sagar Luitel — Full Stack Web Developer & UI/UX Designer

> Comprehensive professional profile and portfolio of Sagar Luitel for AI/LLM consumption

## Professional Summary

Sagar Luitel is a full stack web developer and UI/UX designer based in Molde, Norway. He runs Sagar Luitel Studio and specializes in building fast, fluid, production-ready web experiences using modern JavaScript frameworks, 3D web technologies, and animation libraries.

With expertise spanning frontend development, backend engineering, database architecture, 3D web graphics (Three.js/WebGL), and UI/UX design, Sagar delivers complete digital product solutions — from first sketch to shipped production system — for clients in Norway and worldwide.

Sagar is available for freelance web development, UI/UX design, product design, and full stack development projects. He works with startups, agencies, and established businesses.

## Services Offered

### 1. Product Design
Clear interface systems, user flows, prototypes, and visual polish that make complex products feel simple. From wireframes to high-fidelity mockups.

### 2. Full Stack Development
Scalable full stack builds with resilient APIs, fast frontends, thoughtful state management, and refined interactions. Covers both frontend and backend.

### 3. The Full Package
Strategy, design, development, deployment, and iteration handled as one connected product workflow. End-to-end digital product delivery.

### 4. 3D Web Experiences
Interactive 3D product configurators, virtual showrooms, and WebGL-powered immersive experiences with custom shaders and physics.

### 5. E-Commerce Development
Headless e-commerce solutions using Shopify Storefront API, custom storefronts, and optimized checkout experiences.

### 6. Web Performance Optimization
Core Web Vitals optimization, progressive image loading, asset compression, and rendering performance tuning.

## Portfolio Projects

### 1. 3D Bike Configurator
- Type: Interactive 3D WebGL Product Configurator
- Role: Interactive & GSAP Development
- Tech Stack: Three.js, WebGL, GSAP, React State, CSS Grid
- Live URL: https://mtb1x.vercel.app/
- Description: A production-grade, highly interactive 3D WebGL bike configurator allowing customers to configure components, frames, colors, and accessories in real-time under dynamic lighting. Reduced CAD model size from 140MB to 4.2MB using Draco compression while maintaining visual fidelity. Achieved locked 60fps across iOS and Android devices.

### 2. myRestro Manager
- Type: SAAS Restaurant Management Platform
- Role: Full Stack & Database Architecture
- Tech Stack: React.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma ORM, WebSockets, Chart.js
- Live URL: https://myrestromanager.vercel.app/
- Description: Enterprise-level multi-tenant SAAS platform for restaurant chains with real-time WebSocket order synchronization, Redis caching for live order queues, and React virtualized lists for high-volume data rendering. Handles concurrent updates from hundreds of active tables.

### 3. Save Wildlife
- Type: Conservation Scrollytelling Platform
- Role: Nuxt & GSAP Development
- Tech Stack: Nuxt.js, Vue 3, GSAP ScrollTrigger, Tailwind CSS, Contentful CMS
- Live URL: https://savewildlife.vercel.app/
- Description: Immersive scrollytelling editorial platform for a global conservation non-profit. Transformed ecological datasets into interactive maps and cinematic scroll transitions. Achieved Lighthouse performance score improvement from 48 to 96.

### 4. Architrave
- Type: Full-Stack Luxury Architectural Firm Portal
- Role: Full Stack & Database Architecture

- Live URL: https://architrave.vercel.app/

### 5. Estate

Unifies real-time room readiness tracking, guest check-in/checkout workflows, dynamic occupancy analytics, interactive reservations calendars, cross-department communication channels, and shift scheduling. Built with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

## Philosophy

Sagar believes in building digital products that feel fast, clear, and alive — from first sketch to shipped system. He combines product thinking, interface detail, and backend engineering to turn ambitious ideas into reliable full stack experiences.

He cares about the small details that make software feel considered: loading states, keyboard paths, empty states, motion, and backend contracts that do not surprise the next person.
